images.videoPrompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical cinematic Halloween reel. Start with the original person standing still under soft neutral lighting, minimal expression. A faint heartbeat sound builds. The lights flicker once. A subtle shadow moves across their face.

Wind begins softly, hair lifting in slow motion. Red mist creeps across the floor. Their eyes slowly glow deep crimson. Dark veins subtly spread along the neck as fangs extend naturally. A dramatic blink transition — they are now transformed into a high-fashion vampire wearing a deep burgundy velvet corset, black leather pants, glossy thigh-high boots, and a dramatic flowing cape.

Add gothic cathedral-inspired background lighting with floating dust particles, candlelight flicker, bats crossing overhead in slow motion.

Dynamic camera movement: slow push-in → slight orbit → sudden fast cut on beat drop to close-ups of fangs, glowing eyes, cape movement, sharp nails gripping fabric.

Lighting: high-contrast with red rim light and cool blue backlight, glossy skin highlights, cinematic fog.

End with the cape wrapping around the camera lens, cutting to black — then glowing red eyes appear for a split second for loop transition.
